metadata.title: Micron Stock Rebounds but It Will Miss Out on 50% Rise in Memory Prices<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Micron Stock Rebounds but It Will Miss Out on a 50% Rise in Memory Prices
The question of just how high memory-chip prices are going to rise is in the mind of almost every technology executive. The answer looks like it’s still a lot higher than current levels, which is good news for Micron Technology.
